dogecoin.text: Bitcoin surged to a new high of $82,241 on Monday, continuing its rally following Trump’s election win. Other cryptocurrencies, including ether and memecoins like Dogecoin, also rose, as excitement over Trump’s pro-crypto promises fuels investor optimism.

Smaller cryptos like Dogecoin and Cardano have recently outperformed Bitcoin, spurred by optimism over Trump’s pro-crypto policies. Investors are betting on favorable regulations, but it’s still unclear how quickly these plans will unfold. https://t.co/YE0c3dU27P

Dogecoin shot up again after Trump announced the “DOGE” Department, led by Elon Musk. Since the election, Dogecoin has gained over 150%, showing strong retail enthusiasm in the crypto market. https://t.co/HH6p7HTt68

Bitcoin’s rally paused as traders consider Trump’s promise to support crypto with favorable policies and a national Bitcoin reserve. While Dogecoin and other tokens rose on similar optimism, questions remain on how soon crypto will truly benefit under Trump’s administration. https://t.co/AmrweDywBM
